title: Freight Dispatcher
description:
We are looking for an experienced Freight Dispatcher to join our growing team and help manage trucking operations in the United States market.



The ideal candidate must have previous experience working with U.S. carriers and understand the day-to-day operations of the American trucking industry.



Responsibilities:



Search and negotiate loads using load boards.

Communicate with brokers, shippers, and drivers.

Negotiate competitive rates and maximize revenue per truck.

Plan routes and reduce empty miles (deadhead).

Book loads and manage confirmations.

Track drivers and shipments.

Handle check calls and delivery updates.

Assist with detention, TONU, layover, and other accessorials.

Maintain organized records of loads and communications.

Build strong relationships with brokers.

Help keep trucks consistently loaded and profitable.



Requirements:



Proven experience as a Freight Dispatcher in the U.S. trucking market.

Strong knowledge of U.S. lanes, rates, and freight markets.

Experience using load boards such as DAT, Truckstop, or similar platforms.

Strong rate-negotiation skills.

Good spoken and written English.

Excellent communication and organizational skills.

Ability to work during U.S. business hours.

Reliable computer and internet connection.

Ability to work independently and make quick operational decisions.

We are especially interested in candidates who:



Understand how to identify profitable lanes, negotiate aggressively but professionally with brokers, minimize deadhead, and help maximize revenue per truck and RPM (Revenue Per Mile).



To Apply:



Please include:



How many years of U.S. freight dispatching experience you have.

What types of trucks/equipment you have dispatched (Dry Van, Reefer, Flatbed, Box Truck, etc.).

Which load boards and TMS platforms you have used.

Approximately how many trucks you can manage simultaneously.

Your experience negotiating rates with U.S. brokers.

Your expected hourly or monthly salary.

Your availability and preferred working schedule.



Important: This position requires previous experience in the U.S. trucking/freight market. Please do not apply if you have no freight dispatching experience.



We are looking for someone interested in a long-term opportunity who can grow with our operation.

title: Senior Tax Accountant / CPA — Puerto Rico Act 60
description:
We are seeking a highly competent, meticulous tax accountant with direct experience in Puerto Rico Act 60 applications, compliance and tax planning. The ideal candidate combines strong technical accounting skills with the ability to research, interpret and correctly apply Puerto Rico and federal tax law.



This is not a basic tax-preparation position. We need a detail-oriented professional capable of taking ownership of a complex tax situation, identifying lawful tax-saving opportunities and ensuring every application, return and supporting document is accurate, complete and defensible.



Responsibilities

Evaluate eligibility for applicable Puerto Rico Act 60 incentives.

Prepare and manage the Act 60 application process from initial document collection through approval.

Identify continuing residency, reporting, recordkeeping and decree-compliance requirements.

Prepare or review Puerto Rico and U.S. federal income-tax returns.

Maximize lawful deductions, credits, exclusions and other available tax benefits.

Analyze income sourcing, residency, business-structure and cross-jurisdictional tax issues.

Research relevant statutes, regulations, administrative guidance and case law.

Provide written recommendations supported by authoritative citations.

Maintain detailed workpapers, filing records, compliance calendars and supporting documentation.

Identify inconsistencies, missing information and potential audit exposure before submission.

Model alternative tax strategies and explain their financial and legal consequences.

Coordinate with tax attorneys or other specialists when an issue falls outside the accountant’s professional scope.

Respond promptly to government notices, information requests and compliance questions.

title: AI Film Editor – Cinematic YouTube Channel
description:
We are looking for a talented AI Film Editor to work on an ongoing cinematic YouTube project.



We are producing original fictional crime/thriller films designed to look and feel like professionally shot live-action Hollywood productions.



This is NOT cartoon animation, anime, 3D animation, or obviously AI-generated content.



Our goal is photorealistic, cinematic storytelling with realistic characters, environments, camera movement, lighting, atmosphere, depth and professional sound design.



What We Will Provide



For each project, you will receive:



Completed story/script

ElevenLabs narration/voiceover

Photorealistic still images

Detailed Google Flow/Veo motion prompts

Scene order/storyboard

Creative direction and references



You will not be responsible for writing the stories or developing the main concepts.



Your Responsibilities



You will take the supplied production materials and turn them into a polished cinematic film.



This includes:



Generate/animate supplied images using Google Flow/Veo

Follow our provided motion and cinematic instructions

Create believable, photorealistic human movement

Maintain character and location consistency

Assemble approximately 12–18 minute cinematic films

Synchronise scenes accurately with the supplied narration

Professional video editing and pacing

Cinematic sound design

Suspenseful background music

Realistic environmental ambience

Clean, professional transitions

CCTV/security-camera effects when required

Evidence, timestamp or investigative graphics when required

Colour and visual consistency throughout the film

Remove/minimise obvious AI artefacts

Deliver 5 vertical short-form videos from each main film

Deliver 1 separate cinematic trailer/teaser



The Shorts will be approximately 20–60 seconds and used across YouTube Shorts, TikTok and Instagram Reels.



They must have strong hooks and create curiosity without revealing the entire story or major twist.



The separate trailer will generally be approximately 15–30 seconds and should build anticipation for the upcoming film.



Visual Standard



This is extremely important.



We want the finished videos to look as though they were filmed with real actors and professional cinema cameras.



Think:



Dark Hollywood crime thriller.

Photorealistic live-action.

Cinematic lighting.

Realistic human movement.

Atmospheric environments.

Strong depth and composition.

Professional sound design.

Controlled, suspenseful editing.



We do not want cheesy horror effects, excessive transitions, cartoon visuals, unrealistic AI movement or obvious AI-generated video.



Attention to detail and realism are extremely important.



Software Requirements



You must already have your own access to Tools.



You must also have your own professional video-editing software and any other software necessary to complete the work.



Software/subscription costs will not be provided.



Please tell us which editing software and AI tools you currently use when applying.



Music & Copyright



All music, sound effects and other third-party assets used must be properly licensed or copyright-safe for commercial, monetised YouTube and social-media content.



You must be able to confirm that the assets you use are suitable for commercial use.



Weekly Workflow



This is a per-project position, not hourly employment.



Our intended weekly workflow is:



Monday: Full production package provided.



Wednesday/Thursday: First complete version delivered.



Thursday/Friday: Feedback/revisions provided if necessary.



Friday/Saturday: Final approved film and short-form content delivered.



Sunday: Content is published by us.



You will not be responsible for uploading or managing our YouTube/social-media accounts.



Reliable turnaround is essential.



Deliverables Per Project



Each standard weekly package will normally include:



1 × 12–18 minute cinematic film



5 × 20–60 second vertical Shorts/Reels/TikToks



1 × 15–30 second cinematic trailer



Plus revisions where reasonably necessary to reach the agreed standard.



Pay



$100–$200 USD per completed project/package, depending on experience, quality and capability.



We are looking for someone we can work with long-term.



Initially, we intend to produce approximately one main film per week.



There is potential for the per-project rate to increase as the channel grows.



There may also be significantly more regular work available in the future as we expand and potentially operate multiple YouTube channels.



We want someone interested in growing with us rather than completing only one project.



Paid Test



We will shortlist approximately 2–3 strong applicants.



Shortlisted applicants may be invited to complete the same paid 1-minute cinematic test sequence.



We will provide the narration, images, Flow/Veo motion prompts and creative direction.



This allows us to compare:



Photorealism

Flow/Veo ability

Cinematic quality

Character consistency

Camera movement

AI artefact control

Editing

Pacing

Sound design

Atmosphere

Attention to detail



The test is intended to be paid.



Bonus Skill



YouTube thumbnail design is a bonus but NOT a requirement.



Excellent video/AI filmmaking ability is more important.



Communication



You must have strong written English, follow detailed instructions accurately and communicate reliably during the production week.



Initial communication will take place through OnlineJobs.ph.



For the successful long-term editor, we expect to eventually move day-to-day communication to WhatsApp.



How to Apply



Please start your application with the word:



CINEMA



Applications that do not begin with this word may not be considered.



Then provide:



A short introduction about yourself and your experience.

Links to your 2–3 best and most relevant pieces of work.

Examples of photorealistic AI-generated video, especially cinematic/live-action work.

Confirm whether you currently have your own Google Flow/Veo access.

Tell us which video-editing software you use.

Tell us which other AI video/image tools you regularly use.

Your typical turnaround time for a project of this size.

Your proposed price within the $100–$200 USD per-project range.

Any experience producing YouTube Shorts, TikToks or Instagram Reels.

Any experience with cinematic sound design.



Please do not send cartoon, anime or generic AI-animation portfolios unless you also have relevant photorealistic work.



We are specifically looking for someone capable of creating convincing cinematic live-action-style AI films.

title: Vendor Sourcing & Quote Assistant (Google Search)
description:
** Please Read Entire Post Before Messaging **



We are looking for a reliable Virtual Assistant to help source local service providers and obtain quotes for our growing nationwide commercial pallet removal business and B2B product businesses.



We receive pallet removal requests and B2B product requests from businesses throughout the United States and Internationally. These requests come in at different times throughout the business day, so we need someone who can be available and responsive during agreed-upon U.S. business hours (9am - 5pm EST).



This is an
-based position. No phone calls or cold calling are required.



When a new project is assigned, you will research companies near the customer's location that may be able to perform the service, find their website, fill out their online form with the template provided, and collect their
 if they do not have a form on their site.



Responsibilities



Receive pallet removal projects and B2B leads from us throughout the day

Search Google for appropriate local / keyword specific service providers

Find company websites and
 addresses/contact forms

Send quote requests using templates we provide

Contact multiple companies for each project to obtain competitive pricing



Your job is to help us find qualified companies on Google that can perform the work and obtain their pricing based on the keywords I will provide.



You will simply submit the template provided on their website contact forms and collect their
 if there is no form on their site, and I will send the
 from my inbox.



Schedule



This is an on-call/variable workload position during U.S. business hours (9am - 5pm EST).



You will not necessarily be working continuously throughout the entire availability window. However, we need someone who can monitor for new assignments and respond reasonably quickly when a new lead is sent.



Some days may have several quote requests, while other days may have very little work.



We are looking for someone interested in a long-term position. As our lead volume increases, the amount of available work is expected to increase as well.



Ideal Candidate



You should be:



Very good at Google research

Comfortable finding businesses throughout the United States

Able to determine which companies are actually relevant to a project

Good at written English and professional communication

Organized and able to manage multiple open quote requests

Able to follow instructions and templates

Responsive during agreed-upon working hours

Able to work independently without constant supervision



Experience with vendor sourcing, procurement, logistics, trucking, recycling, waste management, construction services, subcontractor sourcing, or government contracting quotes is helpful but not required.



A training video and templates will be provided.

Why strong setters join us

We built a role where your results are directly reflected in what you earn — with a guaranteed base, clear performance bonuses, and a team that genuinely invests in your growth. If you're experienced, consistent, and take your craft seriously, this is a place where you can build something real.

01 — Uncapped earning potential



Your compensation grows with your performance. The structure is transparent, the targets are achievable, and there's no ceiling on what you can earn each month.

02 — Experienced leadership that develops you



You'll work closely with a team that knows this business inside and out. We share what's working, coach on what isn't, and help you sharpen your skills continuously — tone, objection handling, and conversation flow.

03 — A supportive, high-performing team



We hold a high standard here, and we support each other in reaching it. You'll be working alongside people who are serious about their work and their growth.

Base salary: $1,200 USD/month — guaranteed



Per qualified appointment (showed up): $50 USD — every one, on top of the base



Working hours



9:00 AM – 5:30 PM Eastern Time (ET)



That is 10:00 PM – 6:30 AM Philippine Time (PHT).

This is a night shift role. We are fully transparent about that. There is a strong and experienced community of Filipino professionals who work US hours — if that's you, and you're comfortable with it, the compensation reflects the commitment.



Onboarding



Your first 10 days are structured onboarding. We walk you through everything — the script, the CRM, and the process — until you feel fully confident.

Keep your pipeline and call logs updated accurately in our CRM each day.

Receive ongoing coaching and access to the strategies that have proven to work.

A natural, professional phone presence — you sound like a consultant, not a caller.

Ability to internalize a script and deliver it as a real conversation.

Stable setup: 80+ Mbps internet, a reliable computer, and a quality headset.

Comfortable navigating a CRM independently — logging calls, updating records, and managing your pipeline.





What you're walking into



A company with a clear system, transparent compensation, and leadership that takes your development seriously. You'll know exactly what's expected, exactly what you'll earn, and exactly how to grow. We want people who stay, improve, and build with us long term.

title: Apps Script + Sheets Systems Engineer & WordPress Funnel Dev
description:
SALARY: $1,000–$3,000/month (₱57,000–₱171,000) at the full seat · project-based ladder to start · the top of the band is earned by mastery across BOTH sides 



HOURS: Project rounds first → ongoing seat for the one who delivers SPLIT: ~70% Google Sheets / Apps Script systems · ~30% WordPress / tracking / funnel tech



This is a detailed listing because the work is real. If you're the right person, reading it will feel like recognition.



What this is -



I run a live online operation on two connected layers, and I'm hiring one technical person who understands both:



Layer 1 — the operating system: a multi-workbook Google Sheets structure (tasks, content production, scheduling, payroll, testing) driven by a standalone Apps Script engine on live triggers, with remote workers editing daily while the engine writes.



Layer 2 — the web side: WordPress on shared hosting — fast landing pages, tracking parameters passed cleanly through multi-page flows, pixels placed, tested, and verified.



The two layers feed each other, and most failures live at the handoffs between them. I want one person who understands the whole pipe.



The architecture is already built, documented, and working. I don't need it rebuilt — I need it hardened, connected, and made to run itself, surgically, without breaking a live system.



If your toolkit stops at VLOOKUP, this seat isn't the fit. If you write real .gs, build multi-sheet systems that feed dashboards, and are comfortable opening a WordPress page in code view — keep reading.



The hard parts, up front - 



I share these because I want someone who has beaten them before. I already hold a full diagnosis of this system — so your answers don't need to be long, they need to be specific. Specific beats general every time.



Automated writes collide with live human edits. The engine writes on time-based and onEdit triggers while workers edit the same sheets. Runs collide, and things silently un-fix. If you know why this happens and the discipline that prevents it, you're ahead of the pool.



Position-bound logic breaks when rows move. New blocks of rows are inserted daily — and jobs that generate records on those rows silently stop firing. This currently needs daily manual patching. I want it anchored so it never needs a human again.



Roughly 1 in 5 runs of the core trigger fails — silently. No error, no alert. Early work drives that toward zero.

Failures need to get loud. Reconciliation comparing expected vs. actual state — every complete row has its generated links, every date its formatted header — flagged on-sheet within the hour, not discovered days later.



On the web side: pages load fast, tracking fires with the right data and carries parameters page-to-page, and a change to one flow never quietly breaks another.



Why this seat is worth having -



A real production system, already documented. You inherit a mapped architecture with a written operating manual — not an undocumented sloppy system. 



Direct with the owner. No agency layers, no committees. Decisions in hours, not weeks.



Paid at every step, on acceptance, fast. Clear written criteria, quick payment when work verifies.



Room to become the technical lead of the entire stack as trust builds — the system, the automation, and the web layer.



The work - 



Side 1 — Sheets / Apps Script (the core):



Maintain and harden a standalone Apps Script engine across a multi-workbook system



Triggers — onEdit, time-based, onChange — with safe handling of concurrent writes vs. live human edits



Root-cause fixes that hold, not band-aids that break next week



Replace position-bound logic with key-anchored logic that survives daily row growth



Validation, flagging, alerting, reconciliation, scheduled summary reports



QUERY / IMPORTRANGE / ARRAYFORMULA / INDEX-MATCH / FILTER at a systems level — input sheets rolling up into live master dashboards



Sheets ↔ external APIs with auth + error handling



Side 2 — WordPress / web tech (the delivery layer):



Build and edit pages on WordPress — comfortable in code/HTML view, not just page builders



Clean HTML/CSS, enough JavaScript to place scripts correctly and troubleshoot



Place and TEST tracking pixels and scripts — header vs. body vs. page, parameters passed through multi-page flows



Page speed basics: minify, image optimization, caching



Replicate a working page flow to new versions and languages without breaking the original



Always: build on a copy, test, then deploy. Document everything.



What's required - 



Real Apps Script experience — actual .gs code, not just formulas



Concurrency discipline — you've handled automated writes vs. live human edits under real load



Key-based, not position-based — logic that survives rows, tabs, and values being added daily



Advanced formula fluency — the QUERY/IMPORTRANGE stack at a systems level



WordPress in code view — you read and clean markup, not just drag blocks



Tracking you can prove — you've placed pixels AND verified them firing with the right data



Root-cause over patch · surgical over destructive · documented over clever



Clear written English, reliable availability, stable setup



You stand out if -



clasp + a real editor for Apps Script development



Apps Script + external API integration (REST, OAuth)



Master-dashboard rollups from many input sheets, in production



Google Tag Manager · Cloudflare/DNS basics · A/B or split-test setups



You've built for performance-marketing funnels or paid social flows



You've automated real operational systems — payroll, tracking, reporting — not demos



How this stays clean -



Everything runs under my accounts — sheets, scripts, triggers, hosting, domains, and credentials stay owned by me. You work from an access-limited account I issue.



Paid fix rounds: real issues, scoped per round — honest estimated hours × up to $13/hr (₱~750/hr), fixed total, paid on acceptance against written criteria. Estimates are scoped against the work line-by-line, so quote what it truly takes.

The seat: deliver well across rounds on BOTH sides and we scope the ongoing role at the salary above, with bonuses for clean implementation, speed, and reliability.



I move quickly for people who deliver.



How to apply - 



The steps below are part of the evaluation — complete applications get read in full; incomplete ones can't be considered.



Put ACE at the very top of your application.

Share 2–3 projects you personally built — together they should show real .gs work, a multi-sheet/dashboard system, AND a WordPress site you built or heavily modified. Links: code (GitHub/Gist), working sheet copies, live URLs.

In 3–4 sentences — the question that matters most: every day a new block of rows is inserted into a sheet, and a scheduled job that generates records on those rows silently stops firing. What's your first hypothesis for why, and how would you rebuild it so it never breaks on inserted rows again?

In 2–3 sentences: one thing you automated with Apps Script that a formula couldn't do — name the trigger and the logic.

In 2–3 sentences (high-level steps): how you'd implement a two-page flow on one WordPress domain — Page 1 passes a tracking parameter from the ad click through to Page 2 — so the parameter survives the full journey.

In one line each: how you catch a script that fails silently — and how you tell a real fix from a patch that will break again.





Plus — a screen recording (3–5 minutes, required): walk through, with your voice: (a) a Sheets/Apps Script system you built — show the code; (b) a WordPress site you worked on — open the editor, show code you modified; (c) where you placed tracking and what it does. The recording is the heart of the application — it's how I see real work instead of words.



Complete this well → paid test task on a copy of my real system. Deliver that → the rounds. Deliver those → the seat.



I'm hiring ONE person — someone who can hold the whole pipe: the sheets, the scripts, the pages, and the tracking that ties them together. If that's you, I'm looking forward to your application.

Cold Calling Appointment Setter



We own and operate websites that generate exclusive inbound customer leads for local contractors (concrete, roofing, masonry, and similar home-service businesses) across the U.S.



Your job: when a lead comes in for a business we don't have a contractor lined up for yet, you find a local contractor willing to take that lead for free, communicate with them regularly while sending more leads for free then you book a closing call with our sales representative, who signs them as a paying client.



You do not close deals. You get the contractor to agree to receive a few free leads, send them a few leads to prove the value, and set the appointment. That's it. But getting a cold contractor who's never heard of us to say yes takes real cold-calling and sales skill — this is not a passive, script-reading role.



What You'll Do

- Answer inbound calls for leads that don't yet have an assigned contractor

- Capture the lead details accurately

- Find and contact a local contractor who services that area/trade

- Pitch them on taking this lead for free, no strings attached

- Send them a few free leads to build trust and prove the leads are real

- Check in with them regularly to see how the leads are going — are they answering, are they interested, is it working out

- Let us know if a contractor isn't answering or doesn't seem interested, so we can stop sending them leads and find a different contractor instead

- Once they're warmed up, book a closing call on our founder's calendar

- Log every step in Airtable

- Communicate with the team through Slack

- Make and receive calls through Quo (we provide access)



Daily Goal: Sign up at least 1 new contractor per day (get them to agree to receive free leads). This is the core metric this role is measured on.



Who We're Looking For

- Strong and confident on the phone — not timid or shy. You need to sound assertive and sure of yourself from the first sentence of a cold call.

- Genuinely comfortable cold-calling strangers, every single day

- Can handle a "no" or pushback without losing energy or confidence

- Good at building quick trust and rapport with someone who's never heard of us

- Organized — can track multiple leads and contractors at once without dropping the ball

- Reliable and self-directed — this role runs on daily output, not just hours logged

- Clear, professional English, spoken and written



Required Experience: One or more of the following — cold calling is the most important:



- Cold calling (required or strongly preferred)

- B2B sales or business development

- Appointment setting

- Lead generation

- Customer service involving high phone volume



Experience speaking with U.S.-based customers/business owners is strongly preferred.

## ABOUT US



We are an Australian compliance software company.



Australia's new AML/CTF laws came into effect on 1 July 2026 and now apply to real estate agencies, accounting firms, law firms, conveyancers and dealers in precious metals. We help these firms manage their AML program, customer due diligence, verification, risk assessments and compliance records.



We are looking for our first dedicated outbound sales team member.



## YOUR JOB



Your job is simple:



**Call Australian firms (real estate agencies, accounting firms, law firms, conveyancers), reach the right decision-maker, qualify them briefly, and book a 20-minute product walkthrough with our founder.**



You are **not expected to close the software sale**.



Your responsibility is to create qualified sales conversations.



## RESPONSIBILITIES



* Cold call Australian businesses from lists we provide

* Help research and grow the prospect list

* Identify the principal, partner, director, owner or person responsible for AML/compliance

* Deliver a short conversational call script

* Ask basic qualifying questions

* Handle common first-level objections

* Book qualified product walkthroughs into our calendar

* Follow up prospects who ask to be contacted later

* Send simple follow-up
s/messages where required

* Log every call and outcome accurately

* Maintain a clear callback/follow-up list

* Share feedback about objections and what prospects are saying



We provide the Australian business phone number/dialling system.



## WORKING HOURS



Approximately **20 hours per week initially**.



You must work within:



**7:00 AM – 3:00 PM Philippine time**



This corresponds with Australian business hours.



Hours can increase based on performance.



## REQUIREMENTS



* Excellent spoken English with a clear, easy-to-understand accent

* Minimum 1 year B2B cold calling or appointment-setting experience

* Australian B2B calling experience strongly preferred

* UK/NZ or similar Western-market experience also considered

* Confident speaking directly with business owners and senior decision-makers

* Able to sound natural rather than simply reading a script

* Comfortable handling rejection and making a high number of calls

* Strong follow-up discipline

* Experience with VoIP diallers such as JustCall, CloudTalk, Aircall, Dialpad or similar

* Comfortable using Google Sheets/CRM systems

* Quiet home office

* Reliable wired internet (backup internet preferred)

* Good-quality headset

* Reliable, coachable and comfortable being measured on results



## HOW PERFORMANCE IS MEASURED



We care about:



* Consistent outbound calling

* Conversations with relevant decision-makers

* Qualified demos booked

* **Qualified demos that actually attend**

* Follow-up discipline

* Accurate call records



We do NOT want meetings booked simply to hit a target. Quality matters.



## PAY & GROWTH



* Base salary: make us an offer based on your experience (see How to Apply)

* Approximately 20 hours/week initially

* Base paid fortnightly via Wise

* **AUD $15 bonus for each qualified demo that actually attends**



This is intended to be a long-term position. If you perform well, hours and compensation can increase and you will have the opportunity to become an important early member of our sales team.



## HOW TO APPLY



**Applications that do not follow these instructions will be rejected.**



### 1. Start your application with:



**GREEN KANGAROO**



### 2. Send a 1–2 minute voice recording. You can use 
 and share link



Read the following naturally, as though you were actually speaking to an Australian business owner. Do NOT simply read it quickly:



"Hi, this is [name] calling from Duely — have I caught the principal?



(wait)



Thanks Tim — I know I'm calling out of the blue, so I'll be quick. It's about the AUSTRAC anti-money-laundering rules that came in on the first of July for real estate. Thirty seconds?



(wait)



Most agencies we speak with have done the AUSTRAC enrolment, but the compliance program behind it — client ID checks, risk assessments, the records AUSTRAC expects — is still sitting in the too-hard basket. How's it looking at your end?



(wait)



Right — that's exactly what Duely handles: the program, client verification by a link you text the client, and the records, all in one system. Our team can run a quick 20 minutes demo to illustrate how duely can take care of this?.



Would Tuesday lunchtime or Wednesday evening be easier?"



### 3. Objection test



Immediately after the script, answer this naturally in your own words. The agency principal says:



**"We've already an AML template kit, so we're fine."**



What would you say next? Do NOT give us a written answer. We want to hear how you would respond naturally on a real call.



### 4. Include with your application:



* Your previous cold-calling experience

* Companies/products you have called for

* Countries/markets you have called

* Whether you have called Australian businesses before

* Your results if known (appointments booked, calls made, conversion rates etc.)

title: Product Research & Development Associate
description:
# Product Research & Development Associate



**Full-time | Remote | Product Department**



We are a UK-based e-commerce company operating across the USA, UK and EU, with a growing portfolio of health and children's products.



We are looking for a highly **curious, analytical and commercially minded** person to identify the next generation of products for our business.



Your job is to find opportunities, investigate them deeply and determine **whether they are actually worth pursuing**.



### What You Will Do



**Product & Market Research**



* Research new product opportunities within our niches

* Identify trends, customer needs and market gaps

* Find product variations, line extensions and improvements

* Research competitors, pricing, positioning and features

* Analyse customer reviews to understand what people love, dislike and want improved



**Validate Product Opportunities**



Before we invest time and money developing a product, you will help determine:



* Is there genuine demand?

* What problem does it solve?

* Who is the target customer?

* What are customers currently buying?

* What are competitors failing to solve?

* What could we do differently?

* How competitive is the market?

* What price could we sell at?

* What are likely product costs and margins?

* Is this opportunity commercially worthwhile?



We don't want research for the sake of research.



We want to know: **“Should we make this product — and why?”**



### Customer Insight



You will also become responsible for systematically learning from our existing customers.



You will:



* Collect and analyse customer reviews and complaints

* Identify recurring product problems and requested features

* Categorise feedback and identify patterns

* Track changes in customer feedback

* Turn customer insights into product improvement recommendations



You will pass these insights to our **China-based Product Development Specialist**, who will investigate and solve the physical product issues.



### Product Development & Pipeline



Once a product is approved, you will continue supporting development with:



* Customer research

* Competitor analysis

* Target customer requirements

* Feature recommendations

* Pricing and positioning research

* Market trends

* Key problems the product must solve



You will also maintain our **product opportunity pipeline**, research documents, customer feedback and project information, ensuring important insights and decisions don't get lost.



### We Are Looking For Someone Who



* Is naturally curious and constantly asks **“why?”**

* Has excellent research, analytical and critical-thinking skills

* Thinks commercially rather than simply finding “interesting” products

* Can distinguish a genuinely attractive opportunity from a bad one

* Is comfortable with numbers, spreadsheets and data

* Can turn large amounts of customer feedback into clear insights

* Has excellent written communication and organisation skills

* Is proactive and takes ownership

* Has strong attention to detail



Experience in **e-commerce, Amazon, product research, market research, product management or consumer products** is strongly preferred.



Experience with Amazon research tools, Google Trends, competitor intelligence tools and spreadsheets is an advantage.



### The Type of Person We Want



We are **not looking for someone who simply searches Amazon and produces product lists.**



If you see a product with 10,000 reviews, we want you asking:



**Why is it selling? Who is buying it? What are customers complaining about? What are competitors failing to solve? Could we build something meaningfully better? Would customers pay enough for it to be profitable?**



You should be comfortable challenging assumptions and telling us when an idea **isn't good enough to pursue**.



We are a remote female team that moves quickly, takes work seriously and invests in training and development. **We do not do graveyard hours.**



**Full-time | Competitive salary based on experience**



### To Apply



Please send:



1. Your resume

2. 2 examples of product research you personally completed and the conclusions you reached

3. One product opportunity you identified and why it was commercially attractive

4. One customer problem/insight you identified from reviews and what action you recommended

5. One product you think is currently poorly designed or underserved and how you would improve it

title: Business Development Coordinator

The Business Development Representative will focus heavily on outbound customer outreach, with phone calls being the primary method of prospecting.  



This is an active, high-energy sales development role for someone who is comfortable spending much of the day calling prospective customers, speaking with decision-makers, identifying opportunities, and introducing Iacofano’s catering and event services. You will focus on specific industries and customer segments identified by the company, build targeted prospect lists, and consistently reach out to potential clients. You will also support outreach through
 and LinkedIn as needed. 



This role is ideal for someone who is confident on the phone, persistent, organized, and motivated by measurable results.



Key Responsibilities 



-Make a high volume of outbound calls to prospective customers and organizations.

-Introduce Iacofano’s Catering & Events and explain our catering and event services.

, and LinkedIn.

-Maintain an organized pipeline of prospective customers and follow-up opportunities. 

-Work closely with the leadership and sales team to identify new industries, customer segments, and business opportunities. 

-Communicate feedback from prospects, including common questions, objections, customer needs, and market opportunities. 

-Meet established daily and weekly outbound activity and lead-generation goals. 

-Represent Iacofano’s professionally and positively in every customer interaction. 



Target Customers & Industries 

The Business Development Representative will help identify and develop relationships with businesses and organizations that may have recurring or one-time catering needs, including: 



-Corporate offices and businesses

-Universities and colleges 

-Government organizations 

-Sports and entertainment organizations

-Event venues 

-Construction and industrial companies 

-Professional organizations and associations 

-Nonprofit organizations 

-Corporate meeting and conference planners 

-Organizations hosting employee events, meetings, trainings, and celebrations

What We're Looking For 

-Previous experience in business development, outbound sales, inside sales, telemarketing, lead generation, appointment setting, or a similar customer-facing role preferred. 

-Comfortable making a high volume of outbound calls throughout the day. 

-Confident and professional speaking with new people over the phone. 

-Strong communication and relationship-building skills. 

-Near-native English fluency is required

-Comfortable speaking with decision-makers and business professionals. 

-Persistent and able to handle rejection professionally. 

-Strong follow-up and organizational skills. 

-Self-motivated and able to stay productive without constant supervision. 

-Goal-oriented and comfortable working with daily and weekly activity targets. 

-Comfortable using CRM systems,
, LinkedIn, and other prospecting tools. 

-Ability to quickly learn and confidently communicate Iacofano’s services. 

-Previous experience in catering, hospitality, events, or foodservice is a plus but not required. 



What Success Looks Like 

The successful candidate will consistently create new opportunities for Iacofano’s through proactive outreach. 



Key performance indicators may include: 

-Number of outbound calls completed 

-Number of prospects reached 

-Number of meaningful conversations 

-Qualified leads generated 

-Appointments or consultations scheduled 

-Follow-ups completed 

-New business opportunities created 

-Pipeline growth 

-Conversion of prospects into customers



Why Join Iacofano’s? 

-Join a growing catering and events company 

-Opportunity to make a direct impact on business growth 

-Training and support provided 

-Opportunities for professional development and growth 

-Fast-paced and team-oriented work environment 

-Clear goals and measurable performance expectations



The Ideal Candidate 



The ideal candidate is someone who isn't afraid to pick up the phone and make the next call. 



You enjoy talking to people, can confidently introduce a company and its services, and know how to keep a conversation going. You understand that not every call will result in a sale, but you stay persistent and continue looking for the next opportunity.

title: Static Ad Graphic Designer - Meta Lead Gen Creatives (Long-Term Team Role)
description:
WHO WE ARE



MSET is a US marketing agency running paid lead generation for local service businesses: contractors, roofers, remodelers, home services, and similar trades. Our static ads run on
 and Instagram with real money behind them, and they exist to do one thing: make a homeowner stop scrolling and fill out a form. Every design decision gets judged against that.



READ THIS FIRST



We are hiring a team member, not a gig worker. Someone we can rely on long term, who becomes part of how this agency operates and grows with it. This is not a beginner role: if you are new to design or have never made ads, do not apply. You will not pass the test and it will waste your time and ours.



One more thing. This post contains everything we require, and we do not take anyone seriously who applies without reading all of it. Your application will show us whether you did.



THE JOB



We send you the raw material: the copy, the offer, the claims, business info, and photos. You turn that into a finished static ad. That translation is the entire skill we are hiring: taking words and information and building the visual that makes them land.



And understand the bar here. Sometimes you get copy and nothing else. No reference, no mood board, no example to lean on. Blank canvas. We expect you to come back with something fire anyway, because the concept lives in your head, not in a swipe file. When we do hand you a reference, you match it or beat it. Both of these are the job. If only one of them is, this role is not for you.



THE STYLE RANGE (READ THIS TWICE)



This is the requirement we care about most. You must have a full arsenal, a real range of distinct design styles, and switch between them on command:



- Bold offer-led promos with big type and hard contrast

- Clean, premium, minimal layouts for high-ticket trust

- Busy retail-style price-and-deal designs

- Informational and editorial layouts that teach before they sell

- Before-and-after and proof-driven layouts

- Testimonial and review-card designs

- Native-feeling designs that do not read as ads at first glance



If every piece in your portfolio looks like the same designer made it on the same day, do not apply. One aesthetic is a dealbreaker here, no matter how good it is.



MARKETING KNOWLEDGE WE EXPECT



- Visual hierarchy as a selling tool: where the eye lands first, second, third, and why that order is hook, proof, offer.

- Thumb-stop thinking: what makes a static interrupt a feed scroll on a phone screen.

- The informational versus visual trade: when an ad should educate with density and when it should punch with one image and five words.

- Mobile-first legibility: type sizes, contrast, and safe zones that survive every Meta placement.

- Enough Meta ad policy awareness to design compliant: no misleading before-afters, no unreadable text walls.



AI: USE IT, BUT IT BETTER NOT SHOW



We encourage AI in your workflow. Generate backgrounds, extend photos, rough out concepts, move faster, we are for all of it. But the finished creative can never look AI-made. No plastic skin, no melted edges, no garbled text, no generic AI gloss. A homeowner scrolling can smell it, and so can we. And we do not just rely on eyes: AI-generated imagery carries fingerprints, hidden watermarks and metadata credentials, and we check creatives against detection before anything goes live. Use AI like a professional tool underneath real design judgment, deliver work that reads human-made, and we will get along great. Hand us obvious AI output as a finished ad and the engagement ends there.



DELIVERABLES AND STANDARDS



- Sizes per brief: 4:5 and 1:1 standard, 9:16 when asked.

- Layered source files delivered with every final (PSD, Figma, or equivalent). We own the working files.

- Fonts and stock imagery only from sources you hold rights to use commercially.

- You design with the claims, numbers, and reviews we give you. Never invent stats, testimonials, or guarantees. One fabricated element ends the engagement.

- One revision pass included per design. We send notes in a single batch, you apply them once, done.



NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS



- Real, provable experience designing lead generation ad creatives. Not just logos, not just branding decks, not just social posts.

- A real portfolio we can open: a site, a Behance, or an organized Drive folder, and it must show RANGE across different styles, not one look repeated.

- You can take copy and business information and come back with a strong visual from a blank canvas, no reference required, without a call, without twenty questions. Given a reference, you match it or beat it.

- Reliable on deadlines, every single time. A late creative is a missed launch. One missed deadline without warning ends the engagement.

- Speed. When we need a creative fast, you can turn a finished static in a couple of hours to a day, not in a week. Fast never excuses sloppy, and sloppy never excuses slow.

- Attention to detail, because one typo in a headline burns the whole ad spend behind it.

- Responsive on WhatsApp or Messenger during agreed hours, with honest ETAs. "It will be late, here is when" is acceptable. Silence is not.

- You take notes without ego and apply them precisely.



DO NOT APPLY IF



- You are a beginner or still building your fundamentals. This is not a starter role.

- You need a reference, a template, or an example ad before you can start designing.

- Your idea of designing is prompting an image generator and exporting the result.

- You have never designed an ad that actually ran with money behind it.

- You have one style you apply to everything.

- A same-day turnaround request would break your schedule.

- You want a one-off gig instead of a seat on a team.

- Your portfolio is illustration, logos, or branding with no ad work in it.

- You need every layout described to you before you can start.



BONUS POINTS



- You have designed for contractors, roofers, remodelers, cleaners, or other home services.

- You have seen performance data on your own ads and changed how you design because of it.

- You can flag weak copy when you see it and suggest the stronger line.



PAY AND GROWTH



$10 per finished static ad, and the rate is negotiable up on quality: show us you design at the level we are looking for and we pay for it. Work comes in batches as we need it, not on a fixed schedule. The goal is one designer who owns the MSET static look long term. Paid through Wise, on time, every time.



HOW TO APPLY



Reply with the word CONTRAST as your first line. Then: a link to your full portfolio, links or attachments for 3 static ads you personally designed that actually ran for real businesses (say so plainly if any were spec), and one sentence on which of the 3 you would redesign today and why. Pick 3 that prove your range, because three ads in the same style answers our biggest question the wrong way. We check applications against every instruction in this post, including ones not repeated in this section. Miss any of them and you get skipped unread.



NEXT STEP



Shortlisted designers get a paid $10 test: our copy and photos, one finished static, 48-hour turnaround. The test is the interview. Pass it and the real work starts.



ONE LAST THING



Put the word KERNING in the title of your application. That is how we know you read the whole post. No KERNING in the title, no reply.

title: YouTube Growth Strategist
description:
We teach people (mostly women aged 25- 55) how to start and grow digital product businesses on Etsy without paying for Etsy ads or posting on social media. YouTube drives more sales for us than any other platform. Most new customers find us through it.



We need someone who does the thinking. You d
 what videos we make. You d
 why someone would click. You check if the channel is turning viewers into buyers.



This job is NOT about views for the sake of views. Every video should help move the right person closer to buying, not just get watched.



This job is not:



- Required to write full scripts. We may hire someone else for that. If you want to write scripts too, tell us in your application.

- A YouTube ads job. That will be a separate role.

- An editor job. We already have people for that.



This job is about ideas, packaging, and content strategy. That's the focus.



----------------------------------------



WHAT YOU'RE RESPONSIBLE FOR



Ideas and Content Calendar:

- Look at other channels, search trends, and our own top videos to find new topics

- Create and update a content calendar at least 30 days in advance

- Start with 6 long-form videos each month. We plan to grow to 8-12 videos each month.

- Pick topics with a clear reason behind them, not just general advice



Packaging (Titles and Thumbnails):

- Write 5 titles for each video. Tell me which one you think is best.

- Come up with thumbnail ideas. Tell the designer what to make. You do not need to design it yourself.

- Watch the click-through rate (CTR) closely. This is a number you own.

- Keep a file of titles and thumbnails that work well.



Content Structure:

- Plan the hook, the flow, and the key story points for each video

- Turn this into a clear outline

- You do not have to write the full script. But if you want to, we can talk about that too.



Short-Form Ideas:

- Give us 5 short-form video ideas each week

- Short-form videos should lead to either long-form video views or sales. We don't judge them on views alone. In the past, we paused short-form videos when they didn't increase views or sales. So we're cautious about this strategy now.



Checking Results:

- Track views, click rate, and watch time in YouTube Studio

- You'll get access to our sales tracking tool, Roaspy. Use it to see which videos bring in customers, not just clicks.

- Each month, share your top 3 and bottom 3 long-form videos. Then do the same for short-form videos. Explain why you think each one did well or did not do well.

- Use what you learn to plan next month's videos.



----------------------------------------



THE NUMBERS YOU OWN

- Average views per video and click-through rate (CTR)

- Sales linked to videos. This matters more than views alone.

- A steady video schedule with no missed uploads



----------------------------------------



WHO THIS IS FOR

You know YouTube well. But more than that, you understand this: in a course business, a good title and thumbnail should bring in the right person, not just more people.



- You've grown a YouTube channel before, yours or a client's. Show us real before-and-after numbers (views, subscribers, watch time).

- You use data to make choices, not just gut feeling. You know your way around YouTube Studio: click rate, watch time, and traffic sources.

- You know a video's job is not done once someone watches it. It should lead to action.

- You share ideas on your own. You point out problems before we ask.

- You can follow a content plan that already works, but you also do your own research and bring new ideas.

- You have hands-on experience writing and testing titles, and picking thumbnails for click rate.

- You have experience with, or real interest in, courses, coaching, or online business content. Etsy, e-commerce, or "make money online" videos are a big plus.

- You write clear English. You will write outlines for a scriptwriter and editor.

- You're organized. You can run a content calendar without being reminded.



Please do NOT apply if:

- You have only grown fun or lifestyle channels, with no experience in courses, coaching, or online business content

- You only care about views and subscribers, and cannot explain how a video leads to a sale

- You want to run ad campaigns. That is a different job we are hiring for.

- You need us to hand you a list of topics instead of finding your own



In short: We want someone hungry to learn, driven by data, and curious about why videos work. Someone who remembers that customers matter more than clicks.



----------------------------------------



PAY

$500 USD per month to start. This pay matches similar roles. As the channel grows and this role helps bring in more sales, pay can grow too.



----------------------------------------



HOW TO APPLY



1. Show Your Work:

Link a YouTube channel you have grown or managed. Give rough numbers from before and after (views, subscribers, watch time).



2. The Project: 

Sample Content Calendar. Make a 30-day content calendar for a channel that teaches people how to sell digital products on Etsy without paying for ads or using social media. These are complete beginners, mostly women aged 25-55. Plan 6 long-form videos. Put one on the 5th, 10th, 15th, 20th, 25th, and 30th. For each video, give us:



- The title

- One line about the thumbnail idea

- 2 to 3 sentences on why you picked this topic. What made you choose it?



3. Short-Form Sample:

Give 5 short-form video ideas for one week, for the same channel. Write one sentence for each idea about its goal.



4. Short Answer:

In fewer than 3 sentences, tell us: what's the difference between a video that gets views and a video that gets customers?



5. Start your application with the words "Customers Over Clicks." This tells us you read the whole post. If you contact me anywhere other than this platform, you will be AUTOMATICALLY DISQUALIFIED.



----------------------------------------



MORE DETAILS

- Fully remote job

- This can grow into a long-term role for the right person.

- A paid 30-day trial before any ongoing work

- Pay can grow as this role helps bring in more sales

title: EXPERT MEDIA BUYER — META & GOOGLE ADS
description:
SENIOR MEDIA BUYER — META & GOOGLE ADS (ECOM / DTC)



We’re looking for a Senior Media Buyer who can do both: launch DTC brands from zero and scale them to 10k/day, and also manage and optimize accounts already running high-spend volumes. This is not an entry-level or “boost the post” role. We operate multiple DTC brands across several markets, with serious budgets and high creative output.



Fair warning before you apply: knowing how to run Meta and Google ads is not enough. If you don’t actually understand our methodology, don’t apply. You’ll be tested on it during screening and filtered out fast, so let’s not waste each other’s time.



You’ll work directly with our EU team.



Who we’re looking for



On Meta: you need know creative is the main lever. The algorithm finds the audience, you feed it clean signal and strong creative.



On Google: you need know the Feed is your targeting. You don’t win with endless keyword lists, you win by structuring the feed to feed the AI.



You need read an account top-down: offer > creative/feed > landing page > account. You consolidate data, you don’t hyper-segment.



Responsibilities



 1. Own the launch of new DTC brands from $0 to $10k/day revenue on Meta + Google

 2. Meta: ABO testing > CBO scaling > MOF/BOF/Retargeting, broad-led, Advantage+

 3. Google: own GMC feed optimization, Shopping and PMax, structuring titles and attributes to feed Google’s AI

 4. Manage and optimize already-scaled, high-spend accounts without breaking performance

 5. Build architectures that consolidate signal, not fragment it

 6. Work hand-in-hand with Creative Strategists, 30+ creatives/week

 7. Diagnose underperformance by layer, not by reflex

 8. Manage real budgets with discipline and P&L reporting



Requirements



META:



 • Proven track record launching AND scaling DTC brands, at least one brand taken from zero to 5-10k/day and 100k+/month managed



GOOGLE — THIS IS CRITICAL:



 • Feed Optimization (GMC): you know that in today’s Google, feed optimization IS your targeting, not an afterthought

 • Consolidation & Scale Architecture: you know consolidation beats hyper-segmentation, and you know when to use Standard Shopping vs Performance Max depending on the stage of the launch



General:



 • Strong on direct-response and unit economics, AOV, CPA, payback, contribution

 • Fluent English, EU timezone overlap



What we offer



 • Remote, long-term, you launch from scratch and also manage mature accounts

 • Direct work with founders + dedicated creative team

 • Serious budgets to scale



To Apply



Send:



 • Brief intro

 • Track record: 1-2 brands you took from zero to scale with real numbers, day 0 spend, time to 10k/day, peak daily spend, ROAS, both Meta and Google



Screening questions



 1. How many brands have you personally taken from $0 to $10k/day? Walk me through one.

 2. What’s the largest daily spend you’ve personally managed on Meta and on Google while keeping it profitable? For how long?

 3. Walk me through your framework to go from $0 to $10k/day with a new DTC product on Meta + Google. Phases, budgets, kill/scale rules.

 4. You inherit an account already spending a high daily budget. How do you diagnose whether to keep scaling or stabilize? What do you check first?

title: Video Ad Editor - Meta Lead Gen Creatives (Long-Term Team Role)
description:
WHO WE ARE



MSET is a US marketing agency running paid lead generation for local service businesses: contractors, roofers, remodelers, home services, and similar trades. Our ads run on
 and Instagram, and they exist to do exactly one thing: make a homeowner stop scrolling and fill out a form. Every editing decision gets judged against that. Views mean nothing to us. Leads are the scoreboard.



READ THIS FIRST



We are hiring a team member, not a gig worker. Someone we can rely on every single week, long term, who becomes part of how this agency operates and grows with it. The per-video pay is how we start, not what this is. And this is not a beginner role: if you are new to editing or new to ads, do not apply. You will not pass the test and it will waste your time and ours.



One more thing. This post contains everything we require, and we do not take anyone seriously who applies without reading all of it. Your application will show us whether you did.



THE JOB



You edit our ad creatives. We send you raw footage (real job sites, real crews, real talking-head takes) plus a written outline: the hook, the angle, the offer, the CTA. You turn that into a finished, high-performing ad that could go live the same day. The outline tells you what the ad says. You d
 how it hits: pacing, caption emphasis, b-roll choices, sound design, where the cut lands. That judgment is what we are paying for.



WHAT WE MEAN WHEN WE SAY YOU MUST KNOW MARKETING



This is the part most applicants fail, so read it carefully. We are not hiring a technical editor who waits to be told where to cut. You need to already understand, from experience:



- Hooks. Why the first 2 seconds d
 the whole ad. First-frame choice, opening line on screen, visual pattern interrupts, and how a hook changes when the audience is a homeowner with a problem versus a bored scroller.

- Retention. Scene changes every 2 to 3 seconds, no dead air, cuts that ride the voiceover, caption emphasis on the words that carry the claim.

- Muted-first editing. Most of Meta autoplays silent. If your ad needs audio to work, it does not work.

- Direct-response structure. Problem, agitation, proof, offer, CTA, and how to compress that into 30 seconds without it feeling rushed.

- The formats that win in lead gen, and when each one fits: owner talking direct to camera, job-site walkthroughs, before/after transformations, testimonial cuts, UGC-style phone footage, offer-led ads, VSL-style longer cuts.

- The offer. Why the hook and the offer have to match, and why a beautiful ad with a buried offer loses to an ugly ad with a clear one.



If you read that list and it felt like your day job, keep reading. If it felt like a course syllabus, stop here.



AI GENERATION SKILLS (TELL US IF YOU HAVE THIS)



We also want editors who have used AI video generation to assist an edit: Higgsfield especially, or similar tools, plus the prompt-writing skill to get usable output. To be clear about the role AI plays here: our ads are cut from real footage, and AI generation fills gaps: a b-roll shot we could not film, a transition, an accent element. You are never generating a whole ad from a prompt, and an application built on fully AI-made videos will not pass. If you have used AI this way, say so in your application and show an example.



DELIVERABLES AND STANDARDS



- Every ad delivered in both 9:16 and 4:5.

- MP4, H.264, captions burned in, safe margins respected for every Meta placement.

- Music and sound effects only from sources you hold rights to. Watermarked or unlicensed audio is an automatic reject and ends the test, no exceptions, because it puts ad accounts at risk.

- One revision pass included per video. We send notes in a single batch, you apply them once, done.

- Edit in whatever software you want. We judge output, not tools.



NON-NEGOTIABLE REQUIREMENTS



- Real, provable experience editing ad creatives or short-form content for lead gen or local service businesses. Not music videos, not gaming content, not wedding films.

- A real portfolio we can open: a reel, a site, or an organized Drive folder of your work. No portfolio, no consideration.

- You can take a folder of raw clips plus a one-page outline and come back with something high-performing, without a call, without twenty questions.

- Reliable on deadlines, every single time. We run ad calendars. A late video is a missed launch. One missed deadline without warning ends the engagement.

- Attention to detail, because a wrong caption or a missed spec burns ad spend.

- Responsive on WhatsApp or Messenger during agreed hours, with honest ETAs. "It will be late, here is when" is acceptable. Silence is not.

- You take notes without ego and apply them precisely.



DO NOT APPLY IF



- You are a beginner or still learning the basics. This is not a starter role.

- You have never edited an ad that actually ran with money behind it.

- You want a one-off gig instead of a seat on a team.

- You need every cut dictated to you.

- Your portfolio is cinematic montages with no captions and no CTA.

- You juggle so many clients that 48-hour turnarounds scare you.



BONUS POINTS



- You have edited for contractors, roofers, remodelers, cleaners, or other home services.

- You have seen the performance data on your own edits and changed how you cut because of it.

- You can suggest a stronger hook than the outline gives you, and you are right.



PAY AND GROWTH



$15 per finished ad, and the rate is negotiable up on quality: show us you cut at the level we are looking for and we pay for it. Steady weekly volume for editors who deliver consistently. For the right person this grows past editing into a creative strategist role: choosing the angles, writing the outlines, owning creative performance. Paid through Wise, on time, every time. We are hiring a long-term team member and we want this to become your anchor client.



HOW TO APPLY



Reply with the word HOOKS as your first line. Then: a link to your full portfolio (reel, site, or organized Drive folder), links to 3 ads you personally edited that actually ran for real businesses (say so plainly if any were spec), one sentence on which of the 3 hooks you would rewrite today and why, and a note on any AI video generation experience (Higgsfield or similar) with an example if you have one. We check applications against every instruction in this post, including ones not repeated in this section. Miss any of them and you get skipped unread.



NEXT STEP



Shortlisted editors get a paid $20 test edit: our footage, our outline, 48-hour turnaround. The test is the interview. Pass it and weekly volume starts immediately.



ONE LAST THING



Put the word SAWDUST in the title of your application. That is how we know you read the whole post. No SAWDUST in the title, no reply.

title: Revenue & Partnerships Manager — Serviced Accommodation (Remote)
description:
Revenue & Partnerships Manager — Serviced Accommodation (Remote)

Company: Accommos Ltd (brands: Accommos, Staymodu, Glowhouse Wellness Stays)

Location: Fully remote — UK business hours (9:00–17:30 GMT/BST)

About Accommos

Accommos is a premium, tech-led short-term rental management company operating a portfolio of design-focused apartments across London. Our properties stand apart through wellness amenities — private saunas, cold plunges, hot tubs and cinema rooms — and a strict quality-first operating model. We hold Airbnb Superhost status and run on a modern stack: Guesty, PriceLabs, Enso Connect and heavily automated internal systems.

We are now building the commercial side of the business, and this role owns it end to end: pricing strategy, demand generation, B2B channels, ancillary revenue and guest lifetime value.



The Role

This is not a lead-sourcing or cold-calling position. You will be responsible for maximising total revenue per property across every lever available — rate, occupancy, length of stay, channel mix, ancillary income and repeat business. You will operate like a hotel revenue manager crossed with a commercial partnerships lead.

You will be the first dedicated commercial hire, working directly with the founder. You will have real autonomy, real data access, and compensation tied directly to the revenue you create.



What You Will Own

1. Revenue Management & Pricing Strategy

 -Run event-led pricing: map London demand drivers (concert residencies, stadium

 events, conferences, school holidays, sporting fixtures) months ahead and position rates before the market moves

-Optimise length-of-stay rules: minimum-stay laddering, gap-night and orphan-night auto-discounting, check-in day restrictions that eliminate unsellable one-night gaps

-Segment pricing by demand pattern: mid-week corporate vs. weekend leisure vs. mid- stay relocation, with different rate strategies for each

-Manage the PriceLabs configuration against a monthly RevPAR target per property, not just occupancy

-Run controlled experiments: test rate positions, LOS rules and offer structures, and keep what wins



2. Relocation & Corporate Demand

-Build and manage relationships with relocation agencies, insurance temporary-housing providers, corporate travel bookers, film/TV production companies and serviced- apartment agents

-Register the portfolio with corporate booking agencies and respond to RFPs for corporate housing programmes

-Pursue insurance housing panel placements (temporary accommodation after floods, fires and building failures) — long stays, reliable payers

-Negotiate corporate rates that protect margin while securing the occupancy floor



3. B2B Distribution Channels

-Get the portfolio listed with serviced-apartment agencies and booking platforms that feed corporate demand

-Build direct relationships with travel management companies and executive assistants at Canary Wharf employers

-Develop a location-hire channel for photo and film shoots: agency outreach, rate card, availability process



4. Guest Upsells & Ancillary Revenue

-Design and refine upsell flows for early check-in, late checkout, mid-stay cleaning, extended stays and wellness add-ons through Enso Connect

-Build packaged offers: wellness weekend packages, monthly-stay bundles, celebration set-ups — priced as products, not discounts

-Launch and manage gift vouchers and prepaid stay credits for the direct site Track attach rates per upsell and continuously improve timing, pricing and copy



5. Direct Booking Growth & Lifecycle Marketing

-Grow bookings on our direct website (
), working alongside our paid-ads freelancer

-Own the guest database: post-stay win-back campaigns, seasonal offers to past guests, and a repeat-guest recognition programme that shifts OTA guests to direct

-Build a referral mechanism for guests and corporate contacts

-Recapture lost demand: cancelled bookings, expired quotes and abandoned direct-site sessions get structured follow-up offers

-Improve on-site conversion through offers, copy and booking-journey feedback



6. Occupancy Gap-Filling

-Monitor the portfolio calendar weekly; identify soft periods 2–6 weeks out and act before they arrive

-Sell gaps proactively: outreach to corporate contacts, targeted past-guest offers, location-hire placements, strategic LOS relaxation

-Coordinate all tactics with the pricing strategy so gap-filling never erodes the rate position



KPIs

-RevPAR per property vs. target (the headline metric)

-Incremental revenue generated per month, by stream

-Portfolio occupancy vs. baseline, with rate integrity maintained

-Direct booking share vs. OTA share

-Upsell attach rate and ancillary revenue per booking

-Repeat-guest rate and guest database growth

-Number of active corporate/relocation/agency accounts producing bookings



What We Are Looking For



Must have

-3+ years in revenue management, commercial or business development within short- term rentals, serviced apartments, hotels, corporate housing or relocation services

-Demonstrable record of revenue you personally generated or grew — you will be asked for specifics and numbers

-Working command of revenue metrics: occupancy, ADR, RevPAR, LOS, channel contribution, attach rate

-Excellent spoken and written English; confident and credible on calls with UK corporate clients and agents

-Consultative selling style: you listen, diagnose and propose — you do not script-read Comfortable running structured experiments and reading the results honestly Reliable remote setup: quiet workspace, quality headset, stable internet

-Available during UK business hours



Strongly preferred

-Hands-on experience with dynamic pricing tools (PriceLabs, Wheelhouse, Beyond) and a PMS (Guesty or comparable)

-Existing knowledge of the London accommodation market and its event calendar

-Familiarity with relocation agents, insurance housing, TMCs or serviced-apartment agencies


/CRM lifecycle marketing experience



Compensation Structure

-Base: £1,000–£1,400/month depending on experience

-Commission: percentage of incremental revenue across corporate bookings, upsells, ancillary income and direct bookings (structure shared at interview; uncapped)

-Quarterly RevPAR bonus when the portfolio exceeds target

-Realistic year-one on-target earnings: £20,000–£30,000+



Why This Role Is Worth Your Attention

-Ground-floor commercial hire in a profitable, growing company — you build the function

-Direct line to the founder; decisions in days, not quarters

-A genuinely differentiated product to sell: wellness-led properties that photograph well, review well and command premium rates

-Full access to the levers: pricing, channels, partnerships, marketing — not a narrow patch

-Compensation that scales with the results you deliver



How to Apply

Begin your application with the word “sauna” so we know you read this far. Then include:

Applications without all three items will not be reviewed.

title: Instagram DM Outreach Specialist — UK Fitness Niche (Part-Time, Long-Term)
description:
Hi! I run a video editing agency for UK fitness coaches and I'm hiring a reliable Virtual Assistant to handle cold DM outreach on Instagram across two of my brand accounts.

English requirement (read first):

You MUST be able to write fluent, natural-sounding English. This role involves writing a personalized opening line for each prospect, and the message has to read like a real native English speaker wrote it. Generic copy-paste DMs will not work. If your written English is not excellent, please do not apply.

What you'll do:

Each morning I'll send you 1–3 source Instagram accounts (other UK fitness coaches with big followings). Your job is to:



Open those accounts and scroll through their followers (and/or who they follow)

Find UK-based fitness coaches who match the criteria below

DM each prospect using my template, with a personalized opening line referencing their content



How to pick good prospects from the source accounts:



UK-based (check bio/location/content references)

1,000–50,000 followers

Posts regularly (active in the last 2 weeks)

Personal brand/coach (not a gym, brand, or company page)

Fitness/coaching niche (not nutritionist, physio, yoga unless they coach)



Daily flow:



3 sessions per day, ~45 mins each, working UK time, Monday–Friday only

Sessions: 8am UK / 1pm UK / 8pm UK (= 3pm / 8pm / 3am Manila)

Volume: starts at ~15 DMs/day in week 1, ramps to 100–120 DMs/day across both accounts by week 4

Log every DM in a Google Sheet (provided) so we don't double-message anyone

WhatsApp summary at end of each day (numbers sent, any issues)

Pause and notify me immediately if any IG warning or restriction appears



Important — what you will NOT do:



You will NOT open or read any incoming DMs/replies. I handle ALL replies myself.

If you a
 open a reply, mark it as unread immediately.

You will not book sales calls or message anyone outside the daily brief.



Personalization example:

Look at the prospect's last 2–3 posts and reference one specifically.

GOOD:



"Hey [name], loved your recent reel on macro tracking — solid breakdown. Quick question — are you editing your videos yourself?"



BAD:



"Hey, love your content!"



If you can't write the GOOD example in fluent English, this role isn't for you.

What I'm looking for:



Excellent written English (essential)

Stable internet

Phone or laptop (phone preferred — safer for IG accounts)

Reliable schedule — Mon–Fri, UK hours including the late evening session

Previous IG outreach or social media VA experience preferred

Follows a written brief without going off-script



Pay:

$320/month flat, paid weekly via Wise every Friday ($80/week)

Hours:

~12 hours per week (3 sessions/day × ~45 mins × 5 days)

Trial:

2-week paid trial. If it's a good fit, ongoing long-term role.

To apply, send a 2-minute Loom video (
 — free) answering:



Have you done Instagram outreach for a client before? Tell me about it.

Imagine you're DMing a UK fitness coach with 5k followers whose last reel was about post-workout nutrition. Write me an actual personalized opening line you'd send them.

Confirm you can work UK hours (8am / 1pm / 8pm UK), Mon–Fri.



Applications without a Loom will not be considered.

Looking to hire this week.
